problem: A protected-main product-led homepage change was merged while Netlify production remained on an older commit, so code truth and production truth diverged.
decision: When production lags protected main, create one bounded promotion candidate that forces a fresh Netlify build and cannot close until provider commit_ref and public content readback both match the promoted lineage.
prevention: Never treat merge-to-main as production completion.
A redeploy heartbeat must preserve the canonical Netlify build chain, including apply-product-led-home.mjs.
Promotion closure requires provider commit_ref plus public homepage content evidence.
root_cause: Netlify did not automatically promote the merged product-led homepage lineage, leaving production on an older commit.
